description: This file contains helper functions and types for building and managing the installation plan of a gateway daemon, including environment variable collection, security checks, and runtime configuration.

methods.name: collectAuthProfileServiceEnvVars
methods.description: Collects environment variables from auth profile credentials, applying security checks and filtering.

methods.name: buildGatewayInstallEnvironment
methods.description: Builds the environment variables for gateway installation, merging various sources.

methods.name: buildGatewayInstallPlan
methods.description: Asynchronously constructs the full installation plan for the gateway, including environment setup and runtime configuration.

methods.name: gatewayInstallErrorHint
methods.description: Provides platform-specific tips for resolving installation errors.
